name: Wild Shape
desc: As a Bonus Action you shape-shift into a Beast form you know (the 🐾 Wild Shape button in Status). You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Druid level; your own Hit Points stay, and damage takes the temporary ones first. The form lasts a number of hours equal to half your Druid level, until you leave it as a Bonus Action, become Incapacitated, die or use Wild Shape again. You can't cast spells, but Concentration isn't broken. You regain one use on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest. Known forms: 4 at level 2, 6 at level 4, 8 at level 8.
